content:
Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) has invited online applications for Bus Conductor recruitment.

Eligible candidates should apply through the official UPSRTC portal, keep educational and licence documents ready, and track exam/admit card updates on the same website.
